paper_title: SEP-NMPC: Safety Enhanced Passivity-Based Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for a UAV Slung Payload System
authors: Seyedreza Rezaei; Junjie Kang; Amaldev Haridevan; Jinjun Shan
payload_model: point-mass payload; massless rigid cable; two swing angles
disturbance_handling: nominal coupled dynamics; moving-obstacle signals; no future wind feedforward specified
constraints: input/angle sets U and A; strict passivity; HOCBF clearance
code_license: No code identified; paper is under arXiv license
experimental_validation: simulations and real-world experiments reported by original paper
rejection_reason: Five-link support requires a frozen reduced internal model; this is adaptation, not native support.

paper_title: Robust finite-time anti-swing control for quadrotor slung-load system based on compensation function observer
authors: Xiaoning Yu; Liaozhang Li; Kun Yan; Jiayong Fang; Peng Zhang; Bo Cheng
uav_model: quadrotor position loop with attitude/thrust realization
payload_model: rigid string; massless and inelastic; payload mass; two swing angles
disturbance_handling: bounded unknown disturbance; compensation function observer
constraints: paper controller parameters; no explicit actuator/slew constraints
code_license: No code identified; paper CC BY license is for article, not code
rejection_reason: Less compatible with the frozen 20 Hz constrained x-only contract and no real-flight evidence.

paper_title: Robust control of aerial cable-suspended payload transportation via fully actuated system approach
control_family: fully actuated system + cascade + disturbance observer
uav_model: quadrotor with outer position/swing and inner attitude controllers
constraints: controller/actuator constraints not fully exposed in abstract
code_license: No code identified; article CC license, no code license
experimental_validation: simulations and experiments reported by original paper
rejection_reason: Requires its own inner-loop attitude controller and does not naturally expose only x acceleration.

paper_title: Finite-time swing attenuation for differentially flat quadrotor slung-load systems via robust AFITSM-OSMC partitioned control
authors: Huiyu Sun; Xinyan Gu; Kun Zheng; Zhong Wei
control_family: differential flatness + adaptive terminal sliding mode
uav_model: quadrotor slung-load with flat outputs and FAS/UAS partition
payload_model: point-mass payload; massless taut cable; single suspended load
disturbance_handling: lumped uncertainty and dynamic load variation
constraints: sliding surfaces and actuator/torque limits are controller-specific
rejection_reason: Full flatness/attitude/torque realization cannot be separated fairly into the frozen x-acceleration interface.

paper_title: Trajectory tracking control for quadrotor slung-load system: A fuzzy pre-compensation active disturbance rejection control approach
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part I
payload_model: slung-load model; details are not a five-link model
constraints: paper reports controller structure; explicit frozen acceleration/slew constraints not specified
experimental_validation: trajectory-tracking simulation with five control schemes reported by original paper
rejection_reason: Anti-swing is not the explicit controller objective and the stated fuzzy/ADRC interface needs a major contract rewrite.

paper_title: Modeling and Control for UAV with Off-center Slung Load
authors: Zongyang Lv; Yanmei Jia; Yongqing Liu; Alan F. Lynch; Qing Zhao; Yuhu Wu
payload_model: single slung load; suspension point offset; cable model
disturbance_handling: no explicit wind/disturbance estimator in abstract
constraints: not specified in abstract; inner attitude tracking is part of method
code_license: No code identified; arXiv paper license only
experimental_validation: simulations and experiments reported by original paper
rejection_reason: The method designs its own attitude inner loop and is tied to off-center geometry absent from the current plant.

paper_title: Residual-learning-enhanced extended Kalman filter for real-time swing angle estimation in quadrotor-suspended-payload systems
authors: Yihang Zhang; Jun Shen; Hongling Qiu; Mingxuan Sha
disturbance_handling: model mismatch from aerodynamic disturbance and coupling
constraints: estimator measurement/update equations; no control law
code_license: No code identified; CC BY-NC-ND article license, no code license
experimental_validation: estimation experiments reported by original paper
rejection_reason: It is not an anti-swing controller and cannot be the requested external control baseline.

paper_title: Decentralized Geometric Control for Cable-Suspended Payload Transport with Adaptive Mass Estimation
authors: Hadi Hajieghrary; Benedikt Walter; Paul Schmitt; Miguel Hurtado
control_family: decentralized geometric control + ESO + adaptive estimation + safety filter
payload_model: flexible cables with beads; cooperative payload
code_license: No code identified; arXiv paper license only
experimental_validation: high-fidelity simulation reported by original paper
rejection_reason: Multi-UAV cooperative architecture, full geometric inputs, and flexible-cable model cannot be fairly reduced to one UAV x acceleration.
